content_of_post_to_answer: Why does minimalism and a clean space make me feel so peaceful and just so good?
answer: A clean space often feels peaceful because it reduces the number of decisions your mind has to process. Every object in your environment carries a small demand: notice me, remember me, deal with me. Removing excess does not just create physical order; it creates mental quiet. The interesting distinction is that minimalism is not really about owning fewer things, but about reducing the amount of attention your surroundings constantly ask from you. A peaceful room is one that gives your mind somewhere to rest.
